Intake note (Commercial team, 28 December 2020). Our client Rupali Rathore is a 58-year-old restaurant owner who lives at House No. 30, Kuvempunagar, Mysuru 570027 and can be reached on +91 99696 45940 or rupali.rathore@example.in. The client's PAN MBJPR3528F.
